POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Rohan Joshi | Age: 55
Body Temperature at Scene: 24.8°C | Ambient Temperature: 30.2°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 17.0 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  2. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  3. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  4. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  5. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
